paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -4.50% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (-1.77%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-7.70%). Brent crude changed -5.05% to 87.77. Gold changed -4.72% to 3,671.2. Bitcoin changed -0.12% to 62,911.3281. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of -3.30%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-10.15%) and Newmont (-8.94%) moved the most.
